description: Main window: native file dialogs, OS opener (open-path and, since UI-40, reveal-item-in-dir for *Open containing folder*), scoped asset reads for the covers cache (DR-44), the window commands the toolbar's own chrome needs (UI-07, D2): the three control buttons, the `start_dragging` call Tauri's drag-region script makes on the strip (DR-103), and `destroy`, which Tauri's own `onCloseRequested` plumbing calls to finish a close the app did not prevent (DR-105); and `set_size`, which only the smoke harness calls to measure the AC-35/AC-39 layouts at the window widths the ACs name — no product code calls it (DR-122); and, since FR-25 (DR-321/DR-329), `updater:default` — the updater plugin's check/download/install commands for the app's self-update flow (reader windows carry the same grant since DR-344 — the chrome menu's *Check for updates* runs and reports in the window it was invoked from); and, since the update completion path of FR-25 (DR-418/DR-422, SPEC-v0.0.13 §3.3), `process:allow-restart` — the self-restart after a completed in-app update on macOS/Linux, granted to the reader windows as well for the same reason. No other capability is granted (RULES R1.5).
